description: Teach a relation to link itself: give it field pairs, and a record on one side links to a record on the other whenever ALL the pairs match — e.g. this database's `customer_email` equals the target's `email`. Setting a rule does NOT link anything that already exists (run_auto_link links existing records). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES set_auto_link"]

conditions.description: 1–5 field pairs. field_a is on THIS database, field_b on the target. Names or ids.

relation.description: The relation FIELD on this database (name or api_name), or a relation id.

name: set_auto_link
title: Set auto-link rules
